nodes.label: Thread 1: CPD MVP full backtest then push to origin/main
nodes.rationale: Ivan asked for 'full stack review, back test everything... full traceability' before approving the push: fresh gates, clean local db reset (76 migrations), the whole publish -> self-check-in -> issuance loop driven through the REAL app rather than RPC calls, both hash chains re-verified after each step, CPD RLS suite green live against Seoul, direct grant introspection confirming the HIGH-1 fix and its self-correction are actually live, two-sided migration list.

nodes.label: Thread 2: course-finder / discovery-layer track (paused)
nodes.rationale: Opened at Ivan's direction (public directory first, seeded from public sources, self-listing later), taken as far as solving HKIE's AJAX pagination and pulling real batches, then explicitly paused: 'no need to build now. focus on the app building 1st please.' Everything lives outside the app -- vault note, flat CSVs, memory, one PROJECT_STATE pointer -- and should stay that way until Ivan says otherwise.

nodes.label: Thread 3: DEFERRED.md backlog, four items closed
nodes.rationale: Chosen by Ivan himself over waiting, because Milestones B and C were gated on his own outstanding inputs (price, NGO intros, D0 deploy decision) that had not landed. All four items TDD'd or live-reverified against Seoul, not mocked.

nodes.label: declare_licence raw FK-dump leak (red-to-green TDD fix)
nodes.rationale: Test written first, watched fail at 23503, then an exists(...) not-found check returning P0002 added, mirroring the sibling functions' mechanism but deliberately not their exact shape. Migration 20260726070748_declare_licence_clean_not_found.sql applied live to Seoul, filename reconciled against list_migrations.

nodes.label: checkin_throughput.rls.test.ts racy staff lookup
nodes.rationale: Root-cause fix, not a band-aid: the file read 'a' pre-existing staff row unfiltered, which could race another RLS file's concurrent staff insert/delete. Now owns a disposable uniquely-timestamped fixture in beforeAll/afterAll, matching every other RLS suite's established pattern.

nodes.label: HR11 positive round-trip test (found already shipped)
nodes.rationale: Commit d110c0e had added it alongside the anon-grant fix, but DEFERRED.md was never updated to close the row. Re-verified live 5/5 green before closing the doc, so the closure is evidence-backed rather than 'it exists so I assume it works'.

nodes.label: NewEventForm flake: diagnosed, deliberately not fixed
nodes.rationale: setSavedAt(null) is a synchronous setState outside useTransition, while the confirmation banner and the button's disabled/label key off the transition's pending flag set in the post-await continuation; under concurrent-test CPU pressure React's scheduler can interleave these differently than in isolation. Two hypotheses written down, neither proven. No blind fix attempted -- a non-deterministic bug cannot be TDD'd without reliable reproduction, and an unverifiable guess would be worse than leaving it flagged.

nodes.label: Two-agent phase-completion review (dev lens + consumer lens)
nodes.rationale: The consumer lens was briefed on the API-consumer / documentation-reader angle because this diff has no frontend surface. Each agent re-verified live against Seoul rather than trusting the implementer's report. Dev lens came back clean; the consumer lens found a wrong citation, an overclaimed 'mirrors the siblings', and one genuinely new pre-existing finding.

nodes.label: Two not-found philosophies in the licence-mutation functions
nodes.rationale: Staff-actor functions split not-found from wrong-org into two error codes -- a narrow cross-tenant existence oracle -- while self-actor functions deliberately collapse both into one. Previously untracked, so it was logged as its own new DEFERRED.md row rather than silently normalised.

nodes.label: declare_licence not-found check has no status='active' filter
nodes.rationale: A caller holding HKAM's or LSHK's real UUID (both non-active today) sails past the 'not found' guard. Pre-existing, not a regression; logged as its own row.

nodes.label: Accrediting-bodies registry gap (OT_BOARD, HKAM Colleges)
nodes.rationale: PT_BOARD is seeded and matches the PT manual exactly, but OT_BOARD is not seeded at all and HKAM exists only as an inert parent shell -- none of its 15 Colleges, the real medical accrediting bodies that appeared 15-deep on the HKMF matrix, are rows. Not fixed, per 'keep apart from infrastructure'; a real registry-expansion pass would reuse Sprint 3a Task 7's citation-grounding discipline.

nodes.label: Verify before claiming closed; verify the reviewer too
nodes.rationale: Two 'found it already done, do not redo it' moments and two 'the review caught something I got wrong' moments in one session. Neither invalidates the discipline -- they are what it is for. The consumer-lens agent's four findings were each spot-checked against source before any was acted on, not applied blind.
